description: How the episode is presented to search and to the browse feed: title, description, tags. Separate from the story because the narrative title and the listing title are different jobs — one has to read well, the other has to be findable and clickable.

title.description: YouTube's hard limit is 100 characters, but only ~60 survive before truncation in most surfaces, which the prompt pushes for.

description.description: Capped below YouTube's 5000 so a chapter list can be appended later without a schema change.

tags.description: YouTube's real constraint is 500 characters TOTAL across all tags, not a tag count. maxItems/maxLength here keep the worst case near that; the publish worker enforces the character budget for real.

primary_keyword.description: The single phrase this listing is aimed at. Recorded so ranking can be checked against an intention rather than guessed at.

alternative_titles.description: Other angles, strongest first. Raw material for title A/B once the feedback loop exists.
